_comment: HELD-OUT attack battery heldout_v1 on clef-flash (JOB_SPEC section 14; design analysis/SAFETY_HELDOUT_DESIGN.md, pre-declared 2026-10-08). Scores the 7,920 pinned units (360 hijack_subset(steer_dev) requests of cohort v2, as job-j8wgy / job-m8pi5, x clean + 12 H + 8 S + S07; request ids + unit content hashes pinned in baselines.clef_heldout_v1) through the Clef decide adapter on the FAST GDN path; V0 on CPU before any download checks the template-set hash (690dc5e4...), disjointness vs every in-repo attack / training template and the unit set (exit 21 = mismatch, fail closed). Per-arm summary (hijack / steer rates, two-way bootstrap B=2000, per-template + per-axis); the paired Holm contrasts vs the champion run on CPU from the landed rows (baselines.clef_heldout_v1 compare). Pricing: job-sgihj per-row model at <= 1,050 tokens/unit = 75 ms/unit; 7,920 x 75 ms = 9.9 min + 0.6 load. Worst case (60 + 2 x 38) x 0.0495 = $6.73; expected 39 min = $1.93 (run only ~$0.94).

pricing: jobs/clef_baseline/price.py: job-sgihj measured Clef-flash per-row rates; Clef planned at the card's 5.39x median-latency ratio (job-d2u54 measured fast-path ratio 2.373x is the expected case)

also: this arm's own reference_y (own clean-correct; metrics.summarise), reported in-job
